messages:
Nora: Quick idea ":sparkles:" tiny "Winter Postcard + Pinecone Poll" — send a postcard (real or e-card) or drop a decorated pinecone on the kitchen table by Fri 4pm. Low effort, tiny cheer.

Ethan: Pinecones? Im in. Do we have glue guns and glitter supplies or is it BYO sparkle? :evergreen_tree::glitter:

Priya: I can bring a tiny craft kit (hot glue + a handful of sequins). Also e-cards welcome for remote folks?

Nora: Yup e-cards welcome. Put "e-card" or "physical" and your name on the signup sheet: https://intranet.redwood/winter-mini-2025

Leo: Suggestion: add a poll square for "best tiny pinecone hat". Also small prize: sticker pack and cocoa packet.

Ethan: Voting idea: we'll put printed ballots by the box and also allow reactions in this thread for remote voting. Works?

Priya: Works. Remote vote = emoji reactions on the collage post. Ill scan postcards and照片 them.

holiday-bot: Reminder: Pinecone/Postcard drop-off closes Fri 4:00 PM. Craft kit will be on the counter Thu afternoon.

Nora: If shipping postcards, please use the office address with attention to "Nora - Pinecone Project" so mail volunteers can sort. Message me for the address.

Leo: Adding my name. Will probably go minimal: pinecone with a tiny crocheted hat. Low-key but suspiciously festive.

Ethan: I will probably send a postcard from my hometown. If anyone wants a set of extra sequins, grab them by the kit and please return scissors.

Nora: Thanks yall! Collage will go up Sat morning with voting thread. Tiny, joyful, and very low pressure. :sparkling_heart:
